Guide

Thermal springs near Volterra

The Val di Cecina sits on one of Europe's most active geothermal fields. Steam rises from the hills around Larderello, and warm water comes out of the ground in places the Etruscans already knew. These are the springs we recommend to guests staying with us in San Dalmazio.

By Daniel & Eva, owners of Casa La Fonte

Sasso Pisano · free · about 30 minutes

A small village of steaming springs in the municipality of Castelnuovo di Val di Cecina. Near the cemetery, water at about 36 °C flows into an old wash house, and there are small natural pools near Il Bagnone, the excavated Etruscan-Roman baths. The ruins and the small museum next to them are worth a look. Come prepared with towels and water.

Parco delle Biancane · about 35 minutes

Just past Sasso Pisano, at Monterotondo Marittimo, walking trails lead through white rock, steam vents and fumaroles. On clear days you can see the coast and Elba. It combines perfectly with a swim at Sasso Pisano.

La Cerreta at Sassetta · about 45 minutes

A calm thermal spa on an organic farm in the hills above the coast, with pools from 34 to 38 °C. It is the place our team from Convivum recommends most. Book ahead, especially in summer.

Calidario at Venturina Terme · about an hour

A small lake fed by a natural spring at 36 °C, in a pine wood five kilometres from the sea, with a spa and sauna. Easy to combine with a day at Rimigliano or Baratti beach. Check opening times on calidario.it.

Bagni di Petriolo · a little over an hour

Free hot pools at about 40 °C beside the Farma river, near Monticiano. Popular, so go early in the morning or avoid summer weekends.

Our tips

  • Go early or late in the day: the water is the same, the crowds are not.
  • Leave silver jewellery at home; sulphur water tarnishes it.
  • Water shoes help on the rocky natural pools.
  • After a day of hot springs, the house is a good place to come back to: the heated saltwater pool, and geothermal energy that heats the house and its hot water.

Driving times are approximate, from the house in San Dalmazio.

Stay with us

Casa La Fonte is a 400-year-old stone farmhouse with a guesthouse and a private heated saltwater pool in San Dalmazio, for up to seven guests. Dogs are welcome.
